name: Kandori Ruka
source:
A second-year student. President of the Film Club.

Ruka boasts a beauty and proportions that rival any professional actress. She possesses a strong-willed, dignified character, charging straight ahead toward her goals and dreams. Yet her heart is pure and innocent.

The protagonist is drawn to Ruka's overwhelming charisma and wants to create a work with her as the heroine.

She's a true film enthusiast, but her aspirations lie not in acting, but solely in directing. She has been scouted by talent agencies, but has declined every offer.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.cuffs.co.jp/products/recrankin/]official website[/url]]
